'''Notes''':
* <small>{{note|1|1}} [[Edelweiss Air]]'s flight from Bogotá to Zurich makes a stop in Cartagena. However, the airline does not have [[Freedoms of the air#Eighth freedom (consecutive cabotage)|eighth freedom]] traffic rights to transport passengers solely between Bogotá and Cartagena.</small>{{independent source needed|date=February 2026}}
* <small>{{note|2|2}} [[KLM]]'s flight from Bogotá to Amsterdam makes a stop in Cartagena. However, the airline does not have eighth freedom traffic rights to transport passengers solely between Bogotá and Cartagena.</small>{{independent source needed|date=February 2026}}
* <small>{{note|3|3}} [[Turkish Airlines]]' flight from Bogotá to Istanbul makes a stop in Panama City. However, the airline does not have traffic rights to transport passengers solely between Bogotá and Panama City.</small>{{independent source needed|date=February 2026}}
* <small>{{note|4|4}} [[Qatar Airways]]' flight from Bogotá to Doha will make a stop in Caracas. However, the airline will not have traffic rights to transport passengers solely between Bogotá and Caracas.</small>{{independent source needed|date=May 2026}}
